title: "dplyr Basics deck code"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
```

## Import table as meta

Self-contained definition so the document knits anywhere. Swap in
`read_csv()` if you keep the table as a file.

```{r meta}
meta <- tribble(
  ~sample_id, ~group,     ~reads,  ~batch,
  "S01",      "control",  812000,  1,
  "S02",      "treated",  754000,  1,
  "S03",      "control",  690000,  2,
  "S04",      "treated",  933000,  2
)

# From a file instead:
# meta <- read_csv("meta.csv")

meta
```

## Card 2: select (keep columns)

```{r select}
select(meta, sample_id, group)
```

## Card 3: filter (keep rows)

```{r filter}
filter(meta, group == "treated")
```

## Card 4: mutate (build a column)

```{r mutate}
mutate(meta, reads_M = reads / 1e6)
```

## Card 5: arrange (sort rows)

```{r arrange}
arrange(meta, desc(reads))
```

## Card 6: group_by + summarise (one row per group)

```{r summarise}
meta |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(mean_reads = mean(reads))
```

## Card 7: the pipe (chain verbs)

```{r pipe}
meta |>
  filter(batch == 1) |>
  select(sample_id, reads) |>
  arrange(desc(reads))
```
